messages.task:
You are a financial-analysis assistant.

Scenario context (taken from the company’s Form 10-K disclosure):
•  The company maintains an authorised share-repurchase programme that it can start, pause or stop at any time.
•  During fiscal 2019 it repurchased about 2.1 million shares for an aggregate cost of $88.6 million; in fiscal 2018 it repurchased about 3.4 million shares for $195.1 million.
•  As of 30 September 2019 roughly 19.1 million shares remained available for repurchase.
•  Management believes it can fund capital expenditures, dividends, stock-repurchases, pension contributions and other corporate actions from operating cash-flow, credit facilities, A/R sales, new debt or equity issuances, and other long-term financing sources.
•  Management continually reviews its capital structure and conditions in debt markets; it may refinance existing indebtedness to extend maturities, reduce borrowing costs or otherwise improve terms.
•  The filing presents a schedule of “contractual obligations” that quantifies payments due in several future time buckets (fiscal 2020; fiscal 2021-2022; fiscal 2023-2024; and periods thereafter).  Categories include long-term debt, operating leases, capital leases, and purchase obligations.

Your task: Using the available tools, determine what percentage of the company’s long-term-debt principal payments are scheduled for the period after fiscal 2024.
Return a single number with two decimal places followed by the % sign (e.g. "12.34%").

TOOLS AT YOUR DISPOSAL
(You may invoke a tool by specifying its name and the required arguments; the system will return the result.)
1. list_obligation_categories() → list[str]
   Retrieve every obligation category present in the disclosure table.
2. get_category_details(category_name) → dict
   For a given category, return its obligation_type (e.g. "debt", "lease") and free-text notes.
3. get_categories_by_type(obligation_type) → list[str]
   List all obligation categories that share a specific obligation_type.
4. list_payment_periods() → list[str]
   Return the canonical labels for all payment-period buckets.
5. describe_payment_period(label) → dict
   For a period label, reveal its starting and ending fiscal-year (end may be None when open-ended).
6. get_payment_amount(category_name, period_label) → float
   Return the monetary amount (in millions) scheduled for that category in that period.
7. get_average_interest_rate_on_debt() → float
   Weighted-average coupon on outstanding debt (informational; not directly required).
8. list_recent_refinancing_transactions() → list[dict]
   Summaries of recent refinancing deals (informational; not directly required).

INSTRUCTIONS
•  Think step-by-step and decide which tools to call.
•  Chain multiple tool calls if necessary.
•  Provide your final answer only after you are sure it is correct.
•  Output format: exactly one line containing the percentage with two decimal places and a trailing % symbol.
